4009.title: Codex update planning does not reconcile executable and npm prefixes
4009.rootCauseOneLine: Update planning does not reconcile the PATH-selected Codex executable with the active npm prefix; verification correctly rejects an unchanged active CLI.
4009.proposedFix: Verify real updater target selection, then reconcile installation ownership or explain the mismatch while retaining active-executable verification.
4009.caveats: Controlled CLI fixtures and injected host process events reproduce BB behavior twice. Real Codex/npm updater destination selection remains unverified; no automatic fix.
